# Standstill UK Tenders

> UK public sector tenders open now, searchable by closing date, region, CPV code, buyer and value. Free, updated daily from Find a Tender and Contracts Finder.

Guides are researched from official sources, cite them, and are reviewed regularly.

## Guides
- [Selection Questionnaire Procurement Act 2023: 7 SME Steps](https://standstill.uk/selection-questionnaire-procurement-act-2023-7-sme-steps/): Selection questionnaire Procurement Act 2023 guide for SMEs: what replaced the SQ, the exclusion and participation rules, and 7 steps to answer the PSQ.
